facts.business: The Sandesh Limited is a media company engaged in newspaper publishing and advertisement revenue generation, with a subsidiary in digital media.

segments.name: Digital Media (via subsidiary Sandesh Digital Private Limited)

key_risks: Accuracy of recognition, measurement, presentation, and disclosures of advertisement revenue due to complex pricing terms, large number of parties and transactions, and non-standardized pricing on other platforms
Valuation of investments (other than subsidiary and amortized cost) in equity shares and mutual fund units
facts.related_party_note: The Group has not given any loans and advances in nature of loan to promoters, directors, KMPs and related parties.
